import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 1 << 18;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        
        long[][] p = new long[6][6];
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                long val = sc.nextInt();
                p[i][j] = val * modInverse(100) % MOD;
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = n; i < 6; i++) {
            p[i][i] = 1;
        }
        
        int[] id = new int[64];
        Arrays.fill(id, -1);
        int idx = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(i) == 3) {
                id[i] = idx++;
            }
        }
        
        long[] X = new long[MAX_SIZE];
        long[] Y = new long[MAX_SIZE];
        
        for (int mask = 0; mask < MAX_SIZE; mask++) {
            int m1 = mask & 63;
            int m2 = (mask >> 6) & 63;
            int m3 = (mask >> 12) & 63;
            
            long prob = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                if ((m1 >> j & 1) == 1) {
                    prob = prob * p[0][j] % MOD;
                } else {
                    prob = prob * (MOD + 1 - p[0][j]) % MOD;
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                if ((m2 >> j & 1) == 1) {
                    prob = prob * p[1][j] % MOD;
                } else {
                    prob = prob * (MOD + 1 - p[1][j]) % MOD;
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                if ((m3 >> j & 1) == 1) {
                    prob = prob * p[2][j] % MOD;
                } else {
                    prob = prob * (MOD + 1 - p[2][j]) % MOD;
                }
            }
            
            int combined = 0;
            for (int a = 0; a < 6; a++) {
                if ((m1 >> a & 1) == 1) {
                    for (int b = 0; b < 6; b++) {
                        if (a == b) continue;
                        if ((m2 >> b & 1) == 1) {
                            for (int c = 0; c < 6; c++) {
                                if (a == c || b == c) continue;
                                if ((m3 >> c & 1) == 1) {
                                    int nm = (1 << a) | (1 << b) | (1 << c);
                                    combined |= 1 << id[nm];
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            X[combined] = (X[combined] + prob) % MOD;
        }
        
        for (int mask = 0; mask < MAX_SIZE; mask++) {
            int m1 = mask & 63;
            int m2 = (mask >> 6) & 63;
            int m3 = (mask >> 12) & 63;
            
            long prob = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                if ((m1 >> j & 1) == 1) {
                    prob = prob * p[3][j] % MOD;
                } else {
                    prob = prob * (MOD + 1 - p[3][j]) % MOD;
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                if ((m2 >> j & 1) == 1) {
                    prob = prob * p[4][j] % MOD;
                } else {
                    prob = prob * (MOD + 1 - p[4][j]) % MOD;
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                if ((m3 >> j & 1) == 1) {
                    prob = prob * p[5][j] % MOD;
                } else {
                    prob = prob * (MOD + 1 - p[5][j]) % MOD;
                }
            }
            
            int combined = 0;
            for (int a = 0; a < 6; a++) {
                if ((m1 >> a & 1) == 1) {
                    for (int b = 0; b < 6; b++) {
                        if (a == b) continue;
                        if ((m2 >> b & 1) == 1) {
                            for (int c = 0; c < 6; c++) {
                                if (a == c || b == c) continue;
                                if ((m3 >> c & 1) == 1) {
                                    int nm = (1 << a) | (1 << b) | (1 << c);
                                    nm ^= 63;
                                    combined |= 1 << id[nm];
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            Y[combined] = (Y[combined] + prob) % MOD;
        }
        
        fwht(X, 1);
        fwht(Y, 1);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SIZE; i++) {
            X[i] = X[i] * Y[i] % MOD;
        }
        
        fwht(X, -1);
        
        long ans = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < MAX_SIZE; i++) {

        }
        
        System.out.println((int)ans);
    }
    
    static long modPow(long base, long exp) {
        long res = 1;
        base %= MOD;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                res = (res * base) % MOD;
            }
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }
    
    static long modInverse(long x) {
        return modPow(x, MOD - 2);
    }
    
    static void fwht(long[] a, int type) {
        int n = a.length;
        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                for (int j = 0; j < len / 2; j++) {
                    long u = a[i + j];
                    long v = a[i + j + len / 2];
                    if (type == 1) {
                        a[i + j] = (u + v) % MOD;
                    } else {
                        a[i + j] = (u - v + MOD) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
